form.narrative: Rear ended at a traffic signal by another vehicle. The driver admitted to having had several drinks at a party before the trip.

photo.description: The rear bumper of the vehicle shows a moderate dent.
photo.summary: This image shows the rear end of a white car with visible damage. The car's trunk is open, revealing the interior. The rear bumper is dented and misaligned, suggesting it has been involved in a collision. The tail lights are intact and visible, with the right tail light showing both red and orange sections. The car is parked on a paved surface with a yellow line marking the edge of the parking space.
